text:
The constraints lock two blocks: Ben–Cara–Dev in three consecutive slots, and Hana–Ivo in two consecutive slots, with Ivo before Ben. Finn is before Hana and at least three slots away, so Finn, Hana, and Ivo all sit before that block.

The only placement that leaves legal slots for everyone else is Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–8–9, Hana–Ivo in 5–6, and Finn in 1. Slots 2–4 then have to be Elif, Ann, Gus: Elif before Ivo, exactly one person between Elif and Gus, Ann before Gus, and Ann at least three slots from Ivo.

Every other block placement breaks at least one constraint.

CONFIDENCE: 98
